title: STUDY CIRCLE (SYMPOSIUM / WORKSHOP SERIES) FOR ADVOCATES PRACTICING IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT

FULL TEXT:
THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
In Collaboration with
THE GUJARAT STATE JUDICIAL ACADEMY (GSJA)
is organizing
STUDY CIRCLE (SYMPOSIUM / WORKSHOP SERIES)
FOR ADVOCATES PRACTICING
IN
THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
SERIES OF ACADEMIC MODULES – 2026
Eligibility:
Advocates practicing before the High Court of
Gujarat having practice upto 10 years
Seats:
50 Participants per Module
(First-Come-First-Served Basis)
Registration:
Online Registration from the GSJA Website : https://gsja.nic.in/gsjanew/index.php
Registration Fee: ₹100/- Per Programme
Venue:
Lecture Hall, Gujarat State Judicial Academy
High Court of Gujarat Campus, Ahmedabad
Resource Persons:
Senior Advocates and Subject Experts
MODULE – I
(Workshop)
Expanding Contours of ‘Maintainability’ in Writ Jurisdiction under
Article 226 & 227
(Resource persons : Senior Advocates Mr. Mihir Thakore &
Mr. Saurabh Soparkar)
Date: 12th September, 2026 (Saturday)
Registration : 24th August, 2026 to 30th August, 2026
MODULE – II
(Workshop)
Basic principles of Administrative Law
(Resource person : Senior Advocate Mr. Mihir Joshi)
Second Appeals under Section 100 C.P.C. : The Doctrine of
Substantial Question of Law
(Resource person : Senior Advocate Mr. Mehul Shah)
Date: 26th September, 2026 (Saturday)
Registration : 07th September, 2026 to 14th September, 2026
MODULE – III
(Workshop)
Criminal Law Jurisdiction:
Inherent Powers of High Courts under Section 482 Cr.P.C. /
Section 528 BNSS – Scope, Limits and Judicial Discipline
(Resource persons : Senior Advocates Mr. Nirupam Nanavati &
Mr. Jal Unwalla)
Date: 10th October, 2026 (Saturday)
Registration : 23rd September, 2026 to 30th September, 2026
Time : 03 Hours (9.30 A.M. to 12.30 P.M.)
Organized Under the Guidance
of
Hon'ble Mrs. Justice Sunita Agarwal
Chief Justice, High Court of Gujarat &
Patron-in-Chief, Gujarat State Judicial Academy
Hon'ble Mr. Justice Bhargav D. Karia
Judge, High Court of Gujarat & President, Gujarat State Judicial Academy
And The Hon’ble Members of the Board of Governors, GSJA
Hon’ble Ms. Justice Sangeeta K. Vishen
Hon’ble Mr. Justice Ilesh J. Vora
Hon’ble Mr. Justice Nikhil S. Kariel
Hon’ble Mr. Justice H. D. Suthar
NOTE : BATCHES FOR EACH MODULE WILL BE DECIDED UPON THE NUMBER OF PARTICIPANTS.
TEA/COFFEE WILL BE PROVIDED DURING THE TRAINING PROGRAMME AND CERTIFICATE WILL BE ISSUED TO
THOSE WHO HAVE ATTENDED THE WORKSHOP
